name: Normally closed pushbutton
summary: A pushbutton contact normally shown closed before actuation.
description: A normally closed pushbutton has a contact closed in its specified normal state. Actuation changes that contact state according to the selected operator and contact block. Momentary, maintained, latching and positive-opening characteristics must be identified from device documentation.

A stop circuit is a common use, but the generic representation does not establish emergency-stop suitability or the required control-system behaviour. Operator labels, device specifications and the complete circuit remain necessary.
readingNotes: Identify the contact block and its parent operator.
Read mechanical and contact characteristics from the manufacturer information.
drawingChecklist: Reference the complete circuit purpose and device selection.
distinction: An ordinary NC pushbutton and an emergency-stop device are not interchangeable solely because both drawings show a closed contact.
